mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 6 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between the 6-month change in FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals a monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS > 3.0% and 20-day returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0% year-over-year) signals a stable monetary environment that supports equity returns, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between the interaction condition (FEDFUNDS < 2.5% AND CPIAUCSL < 2.0%) and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime, a decline in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines in high-unemployment regimes, or the Rank IC between the 3-month change in UNRATE and 20-day returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 2200 thousand units, it signals strong consumer demand for residential construction, which correlates with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 2200, or the Rank IC between HOUST > 2200 and 5-day returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the past 3 months signals expanding manufacturing output, which correlates with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases, or the Rank IC between the 3-month change in INDPRO and 60-day returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 100000 per month) and declining unemployment (UNRATE decline > 0.2% in 3 months) signals a tightening labor market that increases consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between the interaction condition (PAYEMS > 100000 AND UNRATE decline > 0.2%) and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-consumer-spending regime (RSAFS > 340000 million dollars), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a cooling real estate market that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 340000 and HOUST declines, or the Rank IC between the interaction condition and 20-day returns is below 0.03.
